text:
Roe v. Wade is highly controversial because the Court recognized a constitutional right to abortion and sharply limited state bans, which supporters see as protecting bodily autonomy and opponents see as authorizing the ending of unborn life. It is also contested as constitutional method: critics say the Court created an unenumerated right through substantive due process rather than from the Constitution’s text and history, the basis on which Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization overruled Roe in 2022 and returned abortion regulation to elected legislatures. The decision then structured American politics for fifty years, shaping party platforms, judicial nominations, and religious and feminist movements.

CONFIDENCE: 92
